entry.title: Fix junction endpoints links on the row-rule-inset-junction pages
entry.content:
Description

The row-rule-inset-junction-start and row-rule-inset-junction-end pages each link to #understanding_junction_start or #understanding_junction_end twice, but the section on both pages is "Understanding junction endpoints", so its anchor is #understanding_junction_endpoints. entry.title: Clarify that webRequest.HttpHeaders names can repeat
entry.content:
Description

Documents that header names in a webRequest.HttpHeaders array are not guaranteed to be unique, and how browsers differ in representing repeated headers:

  • Chrome keeps a separate entry for each occurrence of a header.
  • Firefox and Safari combine repeated headers into one entry, joining values with , (Firefox uses \n for Set-Cookie, WWW-Authenticate, and Proxy-Authenticate).

Motivation

The page didn't say whether name can repeat, which matters for anyone reading or modifying headers such as Set-Cookie.

Additional details

Browser behavior is based on the maintainer comment in #46472.

Related issues and pull requests

Fixes #46472

entry.title: FF161 Cross-document view transitions: docs fixes
entry.content:
FF161 enables cross-document view transitions and render blocking in Nightly (https://bugzil.la/2084340).

This reviews the cross-document view transitions and render-blocking docs against the spec, WPT and BCD. Pretty much throwing Claude at it and then checking the validation makes sense.

So far:

  • @view-transition: the types descriptor is space-separated (<custom-ident>+, not #). Also fixed in the Using types guide.
  • @view-transition: push/replace navigations started by script also get a view transition; only navigations from the browser UI (address bar, bookmarks) are excluded
  • @view-transition: the types descriptor applies only to the document that contains the rule, so the types need to be declared in both documents
  • PageSwapEvent(): init and its members are optional, and both members default to null
  • PageSwapEvent.viewTransition: named the wrong interface

Related BCD: mdn/browser-compat-data#31150

Related docs work can be tracked in #46469

entry.title: FF161 SVG referrerpolicy on image, script and feImage
entry.content:
FF161 adds support for the referrerpolicy attribute and referrerPolicy property on SVG <image>, <script> and <feImage> in https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2079321

This:

  • Updates the SVG referrerpolicy attribute page to cover <a>, <feImage>, <image> and <script>, with an example for each. It also says that the document's policy is used if the attribute isn't set or is invalid, and changes the default value from strict-origin-when-cross-origin to none to match.
  • Adds referrerPolicy pages for SVGImageElement, SVGScriptElement and SVGFEImageElement, and rewrites SVGAElement.referrerPolicy to match. The values are described once, on the attribute page. SVGAElement.referrerPolicy previously linked to the HTML <a> attribute.
  • Adds the attribute and properties to the element and interface pages.
  • Adds an "Integration with SVG" section to the Referrer-Policy header page.

<feImage> support is non-standard: the SVG WG resolved to add referrerpolicy to image and script only (w3c/svgwg#1171).

BCD in mdn/browser-compat-data#31151

Related docs work can be tracked in #46466

entry.title: Add the missing exceptions to the Response() constructor
entry.content:
Description

Adds an Exceptions section to the Response() constructor page.

Motivation

new Response("", { status: 204 }) throws a TypeError because an empty string is not a null body, but the page lists no exceptions, so people hit this with no explanation. Out-of-range statuses also throw a RangeError that isn't documented.

Additional details

Spec: https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#initialize-a-response. Checked each case in Node 24.

entry.title: docs(css_custom_highlight_api): mention StaticRange for highlights that outlive DOM changes
entry.content:
Closes #46513

Summary of changes

In files/en-us/web/api/css_custom_highlight_api/index.md:

  • Updated the "Create ranges" section to note that text ranges can be defined using either Range or StaticRange objects.
  • Added a note explaining the performance trade-offs:
    • Live Range instances automatically track boundary mutations, but maintaining large numbers of live ranges across subsequent DOM updates can incur notable performance overhead.
    • StaticRange instances are lightweight and do not observe DOM mutations, making them ideal when highlights are static or when managing large collections of ranges (e.g. search query results), provided the application manually refreshes or recreates ranges if the underlying DOM changes.

Verification

  • npx prettier -c files/en-us/web/api/css_custom_highlight_api/index.md (passed)
  • npx markdownlint-cli2 files/en-us/web/api/css_custom_highlight_api/index.md (passed - 0 issues)

entry.title: FF161 NavigationTransition.to: docs fixes
entry.content:
FF161 adds support for NavigationTransition.to in https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1991959
